reason: Half my orders come by call while I'm serving at the counter, and I can't stop to record each call. So it only covers half my work, and my paper diary already does the udhaar job.
objection: Half my orders come by call, so this misses them. Recording every call is extra work at the counter, and I don't trust a machine with my udhaar numbers if it gets even a few wrong.
would_change_my_mind: If it picked up phone-call orders on its own with no recording, and a person sat with me at the shop for a week showing it gets my udhaar right.
